widgets_values:
PIXAL3D OBJECT HIDDEN SIDES -- research workflow (not yet benchmark-green).

A foreground object gets a real 3D body so a camera move sees its back and sides instead of a stretched relief sheet.

1 - LoadImage -> AtlasInput (solve + MoGe depth + sky_mask).
2 - AtlasSAM3Mask: set `concepts` to the ONE object to lift.
3 - Main relief WITHOUT the object: GrowMask(object) OR sky -> AtlasDeriveReliefMesh.exclude_mask (derive CLOBBERS, so it runs BEFORE the import).
4 - AtlasObjectCrop re-renders the object through a virtual camera aimed at it: Pixal3D's centred-pinhole assumption holds exactly and `fov` comes from the SOLVE. Do NOT use MoGeGeometryToFOV -- it guesses a different camera.
5 - Pixal3D (core ComfyUI, V135+): structure -> shape -> upsample 1536 -> texture -> Remesh/Decimate -> PaintMesh = vertex colours. No UV bake.
6 - AtlasImportGeneratedMesh maps the mesh back, measures its one unknown (scale along the rays) against the shared metric depth, gates it, and APPENDS it. The photo paints what the camera saw; vertex colour paints the hidden side.

READ THE IMPORT REPORT: scale, rel_mad, depth order, silhouette IoU, colour gain. rel_mad thresholds are UNCALIBRATED. The hidden side is a model hypothesis -- no test can verify it.

BEHIND THE OBJECT: the main relief excludes the object, so a CLEAN PLATE (same camera, object removed - shoot it or inpaint it) fills what it hides: its own MoGe depth, registered to the source by one median ratio (AtlasCleanPlateLayer.plate_depth), painted with the clean plate (viewport clean_plate input). No clean plate? Bypass the CLEAN PLATE group and wire AtlasDeriveReliefMesh straight into the import.

Needs: ComfyUI with Pixal3D/Trellis2 core nodes; models pixal3d_int8_convrot, trellis_2_shape/texture VAEs, dino_v3_L_naf_fp32 (see the model note).

widgets_values:
7 · SDR -> HDR (LTX-2.5 IC-LoRA). Runs AFTER the Atlas scene: the frames are either the viewport's baked camera move (toggle USE CAMERA MOVE = true; bake the move in the viewport first, re-run) or the source plate repeated 25x.

No prompt: fixed scene embeddings, cfg 1, 8 distilled steps (upstream example 3bf3ca6). Frames trimmed to 8k+1; capped to ~0.9 MP and a multiple of 32.

OUTPUT: ACEScg scene-linear EXR (half) per frame in output/atlas_hdr_exr (diffuse white ~1.0, highlights above 1 are the model's reconstruction), an HLG master, and a tone-mapped preview MP4. The HDR is a model hypothesis of the highlights the SDR plate clipped, not recovered data.

Models: transformer bf16 + IC-LoRA in V135 models; scene-emb copied to models/embeddings; video VAE uses the conv decoder (ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16 is the best-quality option, not downloaded). Long or big batches can OOM in decode: shorten the move.
